description: This file defines time-related functions and types for UUID version 1, including time calculations since 15 Oct 1582, clock sequence management, and conversion between UUID and Unix time.

classes.name: Time
classes.description: Represents a timestamp as the number of 100-nanosecond intervals since 15 Oct 1582.

classes.name: UUID
classes.description: Represents a UUID, with methods to extract time and clock sequence information.

methods.name: UnixTime
methods.description: Converts a Time to seconds and nanoseconds since Unix epoch.

methods.name: GetTime
methods.description: Returns the current timestamp in 100-ns intervals since 15 Oct 1582, along with the clock sequence.

methods.name: ClockSequence
methods.description: Returns the current clock sequence, generating a new one if necessary.

methods.name: SetClockSequence
methods.description: Sets the clock sequence to a specified value or generates a new one if -1.

methods.name: Time
methods.description: Returns the timestamp embedded in a UUID, interpreted according to UUID version.

methods.name: ClockSequence (UUID method)
methods.description: Returns the clock sequence encoded in a UUID.
